FADE IN:

INT. VETERAN'S BEDROOM - DAY

We see a small, cluttered bedroom. There's a bed, a dresser, and a few pieces of furniture scattered around. The walls are adorned with old photographs and war memorabilia. We see a WW1 veteran, JIM (60s), lying in bed, looking confused. He's dressed in a worn-out uniform, and his hair is thinning.

JIM
(to himself)
What's my name? What's my name?

He looks around the room, trying to remember something. Suddenly, he sees a photograph on the dresser. It's a picture of a group of soldiers, including himself. He looks at the photo, trying to remember the events of the war.

JIM
(whispering)
The Somme... the Somme...

He looks around the room again, trying to remember something. He sees a small, leather-bound book on the nightstand. He picks it up, and starts to flip through the pages.

JIM
(reading)
"March 1916... the 1st Battalion... the..."

He stops reading, looking confused. He looks around the room again, trying to remember something.

JIM
(to himself)
What happened to me? What happened to me?

Suddenly, he sees a man standing in the doorway. It's a young man, dressed in a suit. He looks at Jim, and Jim looks back.

JIM
(whispering)
Who are you?

The young man doesn't respond. He just stands there, looking at Jim.

JIM
(whispering)
What's your name?

The young man still doesn't respond. Jim looks confused, and starts to get agitated.

JIM
(to himself)
What's going on? What's going on?

The young man slowly starts to move towards Jim. Jim looks up, and sees the young man's face. It's a face he knows, but can't quite remember.

JIM
(whispering)
No... no... no...

The young man reaches out, and touches Jim's face. Jim looks up, and sees the young man's eyes. They're black, and empty.

JIM
(whispering)
I remember... I remember...

Suddenly, Jim's eyes glaze over, and he starts to speak in a monotone voice.

JIM
(whispering)
I saw him... I saw him...

He looks to his side, and sees a man lying on the floor. The man's head is blown off, and his brains are falling out from the back of his head.

JIM
(whispering)
I saw him... I saw him...

The young man looks at Jim, and nods. Jim looks back, and sees the young man's face. It's a face he knows, but can't quite remember.

JIM
(whispering)
No... no... no...

The young man reaches out, and touches Jim's face again. Jim looks up, and sees the young man's eyes. They're black, and empty.

JIM
(whispering)
I remember... I remember...

The scene fades to black.

FADE OUT.

The screenplay uses descriptive language and imagery to convey the veteran's confusion and disorientation, and the traumatic event that he is trying to remember. The scene is shot in a way that creates a sense of intimacy and immediacy, drawing the audience into the veteran's world.
